column3: Audit commit 19a07d80, where a receipt-only commit inherited 68 unrelated pre-staged paths from the shared index. Preserve every file and shared history; map each non-receipt path to its owning task/landing evidence, and create an exact-owner corrective task for every illegitimate or test-temporary path rather than silently deleting or rewriting it. Artifact: docs/task-receipts/shared-index-commit-audit-20260916.md plus adjacent findings JSON. Acceptance: all paths are dispositioned with evidence, any corrective work has exact task+owner, and no unrelated work is lost. Retry edge: if owner evidence is incomplete, keep this task open with the exact paths and next ledger/board evidence to inspect.
